does: Finds one data file for a path relative to a module's data folder: walks the load-ordered modules from the last to the first and returns the first <module data path>/<name> that exists, so the latest module that ships the file wins whole; used for single-file data such as the animation attitude and emotion files and the server's relation defaults.

evidence.says: Windows pseudo-code: a loop from count-1 down over the module array at +0x158 (0x118 each), Module::GetDataPath + the name, Path::Normalize, FileSystem::DoesFileExist, first hit returned
the export's decorated name in GameEngine.dll
GameEngine.dll exports this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function
